mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, profile_id, profile_name, dense_enabled, sparse_enabled, fusion_strategy, dense_weight, sparse_weight, dense_top_k, sparse_top_k, fusion_top_k, rerank_enabled, rerank_top_k, final_top_k, neighbor_window, max_context_tokens, score_threshold, query_rewrite_enabled, deduplicate_enabled, config_json, revision, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM rag_retrieval_profile WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND profile_id = #{profileId} AND status = 'active' AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, profile_id, profile_name, dense_enabled, sparse_enabled, fusion_strategy, dense_weight, sparse_weight, dense_top_k, sparse_top_k, fusion_top_k, rerank_enabled, rerank_top_k, final_top_k, neighbor_window, max_context_tokens, score_threshold, query_rewrite_enabled, deduplicate_enabled, config_json, revision, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM rag_retrieval_profile WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'active' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_retrieval_profile ( tenant_id, profile_id, profile_name, dense_enabled, sparse_enabled, fusion_strategy, dense_weight, sparse_weight, dense_top_k, sparse_top_k, fusion_top_k, rerank_enabled, rerank_top_k, final_top_k, neighbor_window, max_context_tokens, score_threshold, query_rewrite_enabled, deduplicate_enabled, config_json, revision, status ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{profileId}, #{profileName}, #{denseEnabled}, #{sparseEnabled}, #{fusionStrategy}, #{denseWeight}, #{sparseWeight}, #{denseTopK}, #{sparseTopK}, #{fusionTopK}, #{rerankEnabled}, #{rerankTopK}, #{finalTopK}, #{neighborWindow}, #{maxContextTokens}, #{scoreThreshold}, #{queryRewriteEnabled}, #{deduplicateEnabled}, #{configJson}, #{revision}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_retrieval_profile SET profile_name = #{profile.profileName}, dense_enabled = #{profile.denseEnabled}, sparse_enabled = #{profile.sparseEnabled}, fusion_strategy = #{profile.fusionStrategy}, dense_weight = #{profile.denseWeight}, sparse_weight = #{profile.sparseWeight}, dense_top_k = #{profile.denseTopK}, sparse_top_k = #{profile.sparseTopK}, fusion_top_k = #{profile.fusionTopK}, rerank_enabled = #{profile.rerankEnabled}, rerank_top_k = #{profile.rerankTopK}, final_top_k = #{profile.finalTopK}, neighbor_window = #{profile.neighborWindow}, max_context_tokens = #{profile.maxContextTokens}, score_threshold = #{profile.scoreThreshold}, query_rewrite_enabled = #{profile.queryRewriteEnabled}, deduplicate_enabled = #{profile.deduplicateEnabled}, config_json = #{profile.configJson}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND profile_id = #{profile.profileId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND status = 'active' AND deleted = 0
